title: Investigate View-to-Cart drop-off
interpretation: A relatively small share of sessions with View reaches Cart afterward. This does not identify the cause.
recommended_action: Review product-page information, add-to-cart visibility, and product availability. Prioritize usability testing before making changes.
validation_plan: Compare product-page behavior and run an A/B test on a selected change. Track ordered View-to-Cart conversion.

title: Investigate Cart-to-Purchase drop-off
interpretation: Many sessions reaching Cart after View do not have a later recorded Purchase.
recommended_action: Investigate shipping costs, checkout usability, payment methods and stock availability using additional data.
validation_plan: Collect checkout-stage events and test one intervention at a time. Measure Cart-to-Purchase conversion.

title: Improve predictive model before deployment
interpretation: The model has weak discrimination and should not drive automated customer targeting.
recommended_action: Add pre-decision product, price and behavioral features. Compare against a simple baseline and evaluate on a later time period.
validation_plan: Reassess ROC-AUC, average precision, calibration and business utility on a held-out test set.

title: Investigate Cart-to-Purchase duration
interpretation: The observed interval is relatively long under the configured 10-minute screening threshold. It is not direct evidence of checkout delay.
recommended_action: Instrument checkout steps and review where users spend time before purchase.
validation_plan: Measure step-level checkout duration and completion rate after instrumentation.

title: Study differences between session segments
interpretation: Session clusters have different observed purchase rates. Because purchase counts were clustering features, this is descriptive rather than predictive evidence.
recommended_action: Compare behavioral patterns and product categories across clusters. Do not target customers using these cluster labels without further study.
validation_plan: Validate segment stability on another period and test whether pre-purchase features can reproduce useful segments.
